game.name: Update RPCS3
game.desc: Downloads the latest official RPCS3 arm64 AppImage from github.com/RPCS3/rpcs3-binaries-linux-arm64 and installs it without touching the factory bundled binary. A sanity probe runs before activation, the previous AppImage is kept for rollback, and the factory bundled /usr/bin/rpcs3-sa remains as a final fallback. Idempotent: skips if already up to date. Note that a brand-new upstream build may require newer system libraries than this firmware ships; if so the probe aborts the install or you can run "Rollback RPCS3".

game.name: Rollback RPCS3
game.desc: Reverts the managed RPCS3 install. If a previous version is kept it swaps current and previous; otherwise it deletes the managed AppImage and the factory bundled /usr/bin/rpcs3-sa takes over. Use this if a freshly updated RPCS3 crashes when launching a game.
